{{Short description|Prize in applied mathematics}}
The '''Theodore von Kármán Prize''' in [[applied mathematics]] is awarded every five years to an individual who has made a significant contribution to the application of mathematics in mechanics and/or engineering sciences.<ref name=mt>{{cite web|url=https://mathshistory.st-andrews.ac.uk/Honours/SIAMVonKarmanPrize/|title=SIAM von Kármán Prize|work=MacTutor History of Mathematics Archive|publisher=University of St Andrews|access-date=2024-05-22}}</ref> Established and funded in 1968 by the [[Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics]] (SIAM), the prize honors the legacy of [[Theodore von Kármán]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.siam.org/prizes/sponsored/vonkarman.php|title=Theodore von Kármán Prize|publisher=[[Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics]]|accessdate=2009-09-21}}</ref>

==List of recipients==
*1972 [[Geoffrey Ingram Taylor]]<ref name=mt/>
*1979 [[George F. Carrier]] and [[Joseph Keller|Joseph B. Keller]]<ref name=mt/>
*1984 [[Julian D. Cole]]<ref name=mt/>
*1989 [[Paul Garabedian|Paul R. Garabedian]]<ref name=mt/>
*1994 [[Herbert Keller|Herbert B. Keller]]<ref name=mt/>
*1999 [[Stuart S. Antman]], [[John M. Ball]], [[Zuccher Simone]]<ref name=mt/><ref>{{cite journal|title=SIAM von Kármán Prize Awarded|department=Mathematics People|journal=Notices of the American Mathematical Society|url=https://www.ams.org/notices/199908/people.pdf|page=911|date=September 1999|volume=46|issue=8}}</ref>
*2004 [[Roland Glowinski]]<ref name=mt/><ref>{{cite journal|title=SIAM prizes awarded|department=Mathematics People|journal=Notices of the American Mathematical Society|url=https://www.ams.org/notices/200410/people.pdf|volume=51|issue=10|pages=1234|date=November 2004}}</ref>
*2009 [[Mary Wheeler|Mary F. Wheeler]]<ref name=mt/><ref>{{cite journal|title=SIAM prizes awarded|department=Mathematics People|journal=Notices of the American Mathematical Society|url=https://www.ams.org/notices/200909/rtx090901119p.pdf|volume=56|issue=9|pages=1119–1120|date=October 2009}}</ref>
*2014 [[Weinan E]] and [[Richard D. James (scientist)|Richard D. James]]<ref>{{cite journal|title=SIAM prizes awarded|department=Mathematics People|journal=Notices of the American Mathematical Society|url=https://www.ams.org/notices/201410/rnoti-p1253.pdf|page=1256|volume=61|issue=10|date=November 2014}}</ref>
*2020 [[Kaushik Bhattacharya]]<ref>{{cite journal|title=2020 SIAM Prizes|department=Mathematics People|journal=Notices of the American Mathematical Society|url=https://www.ams.org/journals/notices/202009/rnoti-p1406.pdf|pages=1410–1411|date=October 2020|volume=67|issue=9}}</ref>
*2024 [[Karen Willcox]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=Prize History, SIAM Theodore von Karman Prize |url=https://www.siam.org/programs-initiatives/prizes-awards/major-prizes-lectures/theodore-von-karman-prize/prize-history}}</ref>
